## Acceptance

<!--
  The candidate must confirm in a comment on this issue that they accept the
  nomination and the obligations described in the policy.
-->

- [ ] Candidate has confirmed acceptance in a comment.

## Endorsements

<!--
  Two current team members other than the candidate must add a 👍 reaction to this
  issue to endorse the nomination. The 7-day comment period starts when the second
  endorsement is recorded.
-->

## Checklist for the team member completing the nomination

- [ ] Two endorsement reactions recorded
- [ ] 7-day comment period elapsed with no unresolved blocks
- [ ] Candidate accepted in a comment
- [ ] Added to [@NixOS/nix-team](https://github.com/orgs/NixOS/teams/nix-team)
- [ ] Listed on the [team page on nixos.org](https://nixos.org/community/teams/nix/)
- [ ] Onboarded per [`maintainers/onboarding.md`](https://github.com/NixOS/nix/blob/master/maintainers/onboarding.md)
